definition: A transformer variant that uses only the decoder stack, generating output autoregressively without a separate encoder.
details: Most modern large language models, including the GPT family, use decoder-only architectures because they are well suited to open-ended text generation.
story: Imagine a sketch artist who starts with static and, stroke by stroke, sharpens it into a face. In plain words: A transformer variant that uses only the decoder stack, generating output autoregressively without a separate encoder. Here is how it actually plays out: Most modern large language models, including the GPT family, use decoder-only architectures because they are well suited to open-ended text generation. The model dreams a little, then cleans up the dream. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Decoder-Only Model.
